title: Search Facet Filter value with . in name
body:
## 🐛 Bug description

<!-- A clear and concise description of what the bug is. -->
I have a facet filer for organization names in my index. It works perfectly fine for all values except those with '.' in their names. I have a name like 'Film.ua group'. I tried searching it in algolia facet search directly and it does not return the name. 

## 🔍 Bug reproduction

1. Add a facet filer names organization.name
2. Add a value with a . like "Film.ua group".
2. Go to the index page on algolia and click on the search icon besides the facet filer. Type the above name. No result is returned.

comments.body:
That's a know bug of the search for facet value feature of the engine. We'll keep you updated of the resolution of this issue.
Sorry for the inconvenience.

While this isn't fixed, this isn't the best way to keep track of it, and can best be considered as a limitation of the search engine for now. You can always replace . with a different token that would not occur in your dataset, let's say `~`, and display that as `.` using transformItems.
